mapper.sql: users.id AS id, CONCAT(users.first_name, ' ', users.last_name ) AS fullName, users.first_name AS firstName, users.last_name AS lastName, users.username AS username, DATE_FORMAT(users.created, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS createdDate, DATE_FORMAT(users.modified, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS modifiedDate, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name ) AS createdBy, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name ) AS modifiedBy
FROM users LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = users.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = users.modified_by

WHERE users.is_active = 1
AND ( users.username LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR users.first_name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR users.last_name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") )
AND users.id IN (SELECT user_id FROM user_groups WHERE group_id = #{filter.groupId})
mapper.select: SELECT users.id AS id, CONCAT(users.first_name, ' ', users.last_name) AS fullName, users.first_name AS firstName, users.last_name AS lastName, users.username AS username, expired AS expireDate, sex AS sex, dob AS dob, address AS address, telephone AS telephone, email AS email, nationality AS nationalityId, (SELECT `name` FROM nationalities WHERE id = users.nationality ) AS nationalityName, password AS password FROM users WHERE is_active = 1 AND id = #{id} LIMIT 01
SELECT * FROM users WHERE is_active = 1 AND username = #{username} AND session_id IS NOT NULL AND DATE(session_active) = DATE(NOW()) LIMIT 01

SELECT *, (SELECT company_id FROM `user_companies` WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1) AS companyId, (SELECT id FROM `employees` WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1) AS employeeId, (SELECT exchange_rates.rate_to_sell FROM exchange_rates WHERE exchange_rates.is_active = 1 AND exchange_rates.currency_center_id = 2 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AS rateToSell, employees.email as email, employees.telephone AS tel, (SELECT name FROM positions WHERE id =employees.position_id ) AS positionName FROM users LEFT JOIN employees ON employees.user_id = users.id AND employees.is_active = 1 WHERE users.is_active = 1 AND users.id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM users WHERE is_active = 1 AND id IN (SELECT user_id FROM user_groups WHERE group_id = #{groupId})
SELECT * FROM `groups` WHERE is_active = 1 AND id IN (SELECT group_id FROM user_groups WHERE user_id = #{id});
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( first_name, last_name, expired, sex, dob, address, telephone, email, nationality, username, password, created, created_by, modified, modified_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{user.firstName}, #{user.lastName}, #{user.expireDate}, #{user.sex}, #{user.dob}, #{user.address}, #{user.telephone}, #{user.email}, #{user.nationalityId}, #{user.username}, #{user.password}, NOW(), #{user.createdBy}, NOW(), #{user.createdBy}, 1 );
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET first_name = #{user.firstName}, last_name = #{user.lastName}, expired = #{user.expireDate}, sex = #{user.sex}, dob = #{user.dob}, address = #{user.address}, telephone = #{user.telephone}, email = #{user.email}, nationality = #{user.nationalityId}, username = #{user.username}, password = #{user.password}, signature = #{user.signature}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{user.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{user.id}

UPDATE employees SET photo = #{user.photo}, photo_type = #{user.photoType}, name = #{user.employeeName}, sex = #{user.employeeGender}, dob = #{user.employeeDob}, personal_number = #{user.employeePhoneNumber}, email = #{user.employeeEmail}, province_id = #{user.provinceId}, district_id = #{user.districtId}, commune_id = #{user.communeId}, village_id = #{user.villageId},
modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{user.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{user.employeeId};
mapper.delete: UPDATE users SET modified = NOW(), modified_by = 1, is_active = 2 WHERE id = #{id}
